
### DNS registries  {.smaller}


* IANA and affiliates publish root zone file 

   * same organization as for IP address, AS numbers
   * (but domain names are lot more politically active)

* For usable top-level domains, there are <i>registries</i>: 

   * VeriSign (VA company) for <code>COM</code>, <code>NET</code>
   * Educause (non-profit) for <code>EDU</code>
   * Registry Services, LLC (under contract with the US Dept of Commerce) for <code>US</code>
   * …

* many registries allow for many <i>registrars</i> who can sell new domains
